children.name: Zostera
children.description: Zostera — a genus of liliopsidas.

children.name: Zostera angustifolia  Rchb.
children.description: Zostera angustifolia is a marine plant with creeping underground stems.

children.name: Zostera asiatica Miki
children.description: Zostera asiatica is a species of eelgrass native to the shores of northeastern Asia: Japan, Korea, northeastern China (Liaoning), and the Russian Far East (Sakhalin, Primorye and the Kuril Islands).

children.name: Zostera caespitosa Miki
children.description: Zostera caespitosa is a species of eelgrass native to the shores of northeastern Asia: Japan, Korea, northeastern China (Liaoning), and the Russian Far East (Kuril Islands).

children.name: Zostera capensis Setch.
children.description: Zostera capensis is a species of dwarf eelgrass growing along the shores of the Indian and Atlantic oceans on the African coast.

children.name: Zostera capricorni Asch.
children.description: Zostera capricorni is a species of eelgrass in the Zosteraceae family.

children.name: Zostera caulescens Miki
children.description: Zostera caulescens is a species of eelgrass native to the shores of northeastern Asia: Japan, Korea, northeastern China (Liaoning), and the Russian Far East (Kuril Islands).

children.name: Zostera japonica Asch. & Graebn.
children.description: Zostera japonica is a species of aquatic plant in the Zosteraceae family.

children.name: Zostera marina L.
children.description: Zostera marina is a flowering vascular plant species as one of many kinds of seagrass, with this species known primarily by the English name of eelgrass, with seawrack much less used, and refers to the plant after breaking loose from the submerged wetland soil, and drifting free with ocean current and waves to a coast seashore.

children.name: Zostera mucronata Hartog
children.description: Zostera mucronata is a species of eelgrass native to the seacoasts of South Australia and Western Australia.

children.name: Zostera muelleri Irmisch ex Asch.
children.description: Zostera muelleri is a southern hemisphere temperate species and New Zealand.

children.name: Zostera novazelandica Setch.
children.description: Zostera novazelandica Setchell is a species of seagrass in the family Zosteraceae found on the shores of New Zealand.

children.name: Zostera polychlamys  S.W.L.Jacobs & Les
children.description: Zostera polychlamys is a species of eelgrass native to the shores of South Australia and Western Australia.

children.name: Zostera tasmanica M.Martens ex Asch.
children.description: Zostera tasmanica is a species of marine eelgrass in the Zosteraceae family.

children.name: Phyllospadix
children.description: Phyllospadix — a genus of liliopsidas.

children.name: Phyllospadix iwatensis Makino
children.description: Phyllospadix iwatensis is a species of flowering plant in the family Zosteraceae.

children.name: Phyllospadix japonicus Makino
children.description: Phyllospadix japonicus, known as Asian surfgrass, is a species of flowering plant in the family Zosteraceae.

children.name: Phyllospadix juzepczukii Tzvelev
children.description: Phyllospadix juzepczukii is a plant species known only from shores of the Russian Far East (Sakhalin, Khabarovsk and Primorye).

children.name: Phyllospadix scouleri Hook.
children.description: thumb|350px|Surfgrass at Hearst Beach, [[San Simeon, California ]].

children.name: Phyllospadix serrulatus Rupr. ex Asch.
children.description: Phyllospadix serrulatus is a species of aquatic plant in the Zosteraceae family.

children.name: Phyllospadix torreyi S.Watson
children.description: Phyllospadix torreyi, Torrey's surfgrass, is a plant species found along the Pacific Coasts of British Columbia, Washington, Oregon, California and Baja California (including Guadalupe Island).
